course.title: Digital Signal Processing
course.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering

content.value: Design an FIR digital filter to approximate an ideal low-pass filter with passband gain of unity, cut-off requency of 850 Hz and working at a sampling frequency of fs = 5000 Hz. The length of the impulse response is N = 5, use a Hanning window.
